content: Piter tah a cangnah zia a chingpase he
Apostol sahlo le Judia raang letei a ungpaw zingtu uny sahlo takhei Gental cawngsaw sahlo zong tah Khazing bia aa cyhlang hrah myca tahpaw khah aa thui.
Macawtaco Piter khah Jerusalem lang a sei tihtah cingpa a taipaw zingtu sahlo taco ama cawh aa mochia.
“Cingpa a tai lypaw cawngsaw sahlo aa ing lang sei ceh ka, aaning khatah batui na e,” tatah aa tah.
Macawtaco Piter tah hming khah a cang naningpaw hrakhei zezongpui khah a chingpase he:
“Jopa khua letah ka ungning tah thlawchang leimei neh ka, apalynah ka hmuh. Paiphaw alaipaw pui, a ki kipali tah vaicung taikhei ka ungnahpaw letah a za tlah leimeipaw ka hmuh.
A chung leco ming neh ka, alui letei a ungpaw saraang phe palipaw, raang saw sahlo, a lai thaipaw sahlo le, avai letei a zy laipaw pavaw sahlo khah ka hmuh he.
Mataico o thui neh ka, ‘Piter, tho tua, theh la e,’ tatah a pa tah.
‘Abuipaw, e bei neh! A pathai lypaw cawh zehmai e bang bei neh,’ tatah ka palei.
O taco vaicung taitah a uihningnah leco, ‘Khazing tei a pathaisah ciapaw cawh pathai be tah kheh,’ tatah a pa tah.
Ma hraco uithung tai cang ka, mataico paiphaw cawh vaicung lang lahchy kaw a cang.
Ma cai ceingei leco Sisaria khua taitah aa va tawpaw he cawngsaw pathung ka tlungnah ing hawkaw aa va phah.
Aaning kha sei pawtah lung langlo tah ung kheh tatah Thlawpaw taco a pa tah. Ma uny paruh zong heh kama kha sei hrah he ka, Kornelia a ing cawh ka va nae he peh.
Kornelia taco vaiming a ing letah apalynah kong cawh ma ching ka, ‘Piter tatah aa ypaw Simon cawh va lá pawtah Jopa khua lang cawngsaw taw he.
Ama taco nama le na ingchungkho vytei pachah naa cang nápaw bia khah a ca ching he a,’ a tah.
Mataico bia rei ka pachia cangkaw leco, Thlawpaw Pathai cawh a hrangthonah letei kaa cung letah a za tlungpaw hrakhei aa cung leco a za tlung.
Mataico Abuipaw tei, ‘Johan taco tui tah baptisma a cangsah he, canghrasala Thlawpaw Pathai tah baptisma cangsah na cang he ceh,’ tatah a reipaw bia khah ka thui.
Macawtaco, Abuipaw Zisu Khri a zingpaw kaaning khatah pehpaw Thlawpaw Pathai lahsong khah Khazing tah a peh hrah pawhe tei a cang caco, kama taco zekhatamaw Khazing cawh ka ei khy a?” tatah a tah.
Ma bia cawh aa thui tihtah aa zongmingtei co Piter cawh mochia khawh lytah Khazing khah aa reithai, “Khazing tah Gental cawngsaw hmai angepachihnah le hringnah naw a peh thlang he,” tatah aa tah.
Antiok khuapui khrisawbu

Stiven kha a peitlenah rawng tei hrehnah a ingpaw sahlo he khah a paipatlaw he ka, Fonisia raang, Saipras tuiraw le Antiok khuapui tai khah phah he ka, Juda cawngsaw a cangpaw cy khah thawngchaw bia khah aa ching he.

Ma duitei cawh aaning letei thaikhehpaw, Saipras tuiraw le Sairin khua taiteipaw cawngsaw sahlo cawh Antiok khuapui lang khah sei he ka, Grik cawngsaw sahlo zong khah Abuipaw Zisu kong thawngchawbia cawh aa va ching he.
Abuipaw hmingtuakhynah cawh aaning khaco ung ka, cawngsaw hlupui tah zing he ka, Abuipaw lang a paleh he.
Ma thongpang cawh Jerusalem khuapui letei khrisawbu taco thui he ka, Barnaba khah Antiok khuapui lang cawh aa thlaw.
Antiok khuapui va phah ka Khazing ningdonah aa cung letah a lang zia khah a hmuh tihtah, a lawng ngetei ka, aa lungthing vytei tah Abuipaw letah a pahnia rua pawtah khei thawzaang a peh he.
Barnaba cawh mehchaw, Thlawpaw Pathai le zingná tah a chihpaw cang ka, cawngsaw hlupui khah Abuipaw khatah a va chuakhui he.
Mataico, Barnaba cawh Saul hui rua pawtah Tarsas khuapui lang khah sei ka,

a hmuh tihtah Antiok khuapui lang cawh a va chui. Macawtaco Barnaba le Saul cawh kung chuh ky khrisawbu khakhei ung he ka, cawngsaw hlupui aa cawngpah he. Hningzuitu sahlo cawh Antiok khuapui lekhei, “Khrisaw,” tatah aa za tah tawsia he.
Ma ning taco Jerusalem khuapui taitah Antiok khuapui lang khah Khazing khuavang thaikhehpaw sahlo a zuh he.

Aa hrong letei Akaba aa tahpaw cawh a daw ka, Rom painah raang ting lekhei cakaang a tlung a, tatah Thlawpaw tah a pa hnisah, tatah a tah. (Ma heh Klaudia siangpahrang a cangning tei a tlungpaw khah a cang.)
Hningzuitu sahlo takhei aaning leh aa tua khynah zaé tah Judia raang letei a ungpaw uny sahlo khah cakaang bawnah pae pawtah bia aa chaw.
Ma hrahei aa tua, aa tholong khah khrisaw macang sahlo pae pawtah Barnaba le Saul cawh aa phosah he.
